Company Profile

A dynamic construction company built on accountability.

I.T. Link Intelligent Contractors, trading under IT Link Intelligent (Pty) Ltd, delivers high-quality building, renovation and project management solutions across Durban and the greater KZN region.

Every job runs on the same principle: think it through properly, then build it right. That's what "built on intellect, driven by integrity" means to our clients — clear quotes, honest timelines and workmanship that holds up.

Led by Siphesihle Mtshali, Technical Director — Pr.Tech Eng.

How We Work

From first call to final sign-off.

01

Site Visit & Quotation

We assess the site, discuss scope with you, and issue a detailed quotation — valid for 30 days, VAT included.

02

Agreement & Deposit

A clear contract sets out scope, sum and payment terms. A 50% deposit secures your place before work begins.

03

Build & Progress Payments

Work proceeds Monday to Saturday, 07:00–17:00, with progress payments tied to milestones — no surprises.

04

Completion & Handover

Final inspection, balance payable on completion, and a project handed over to standard.
